title: Accelerating ab initio melting property calculations with machine learning: application to the high entropy alloy TaVCrW

recollection.structure: Melting properties and phase behavior of TaVCrW
recollection.mechanism: Machine learning models trained on ab initio data to predict melting properties efficiently
recollection.results: Likely improved computational efficiency and accurate predictions of melting properties for TaVCrW, but specific quantitative results are unknown.

score.note: The recollection captures only the title-level idea of machine-learning-accelerated ab initio melting calculations. It omits the specific MTP-for-liquid and FEP-for-TI substitutions, the high-fidelity phase-space reproduction and <1 meV/atom training error, the FEP variance/convergence mechanism and electronic/SRO contributions, and all reported numerical results.
